    Shop unstitched

    One thread runs from Pakistan to your door.

    1. Made by hand in Pakistan.

      Karigars cut, print and embroider each design.

    2. Checked in Dubai.

      We check, press and pack every piece at our house.

    3. At your door.

      Tracked to the Gulf, the UK, Europe, North America and Australia.
